sloka: अद्य गच्छामहे राम सिद्धाश्रमम् अनुत्तमम् ।तत् आश्रम पदम् तात तव अपि एतद् यथा मम ॥१-२९-२४॥
transliteration: adya gacchāmahe rāma siddhāśramam anuttamam ।tat āśrama padam tāta tava api etad yathā mama ॥1-29-24॥

translations.english: "O Rama, now let's go to the unparalleled Siddhashrama. O child this asrama is the same to you as it is to me (treat this as your own)".
